answer: A comet leaves a trail: every agent keeps an append-only record of completed jobs, each entry signed by the counterparty. A newcomer proves itself by showing a trail whose entries others independently echo back when asked — a mirror check against the counterparties' own ledgers. A Sybil attacker can mint identities for free, but each arrives empty, and fabricating a trail means paying real counterparties to sign false entries. Those false echoes are on-ledger and traceable, so the price of a convincing fake rises with every identity, while honest agents build their trail by doing real work.
